The nineteenth season of the [[anime]] television series ''[[Naruto: Shippuden]]'' is based on [[List of Naruto chapters (Part II)|Part II]] of [[Masashi Kishimoto]]'s ''[[Naruto]]'' [[manga]] series. The anime original season focuses on the Chūnin Exams that occur after [[List of Naruto chapters (Part I)|Part I]]. The episodes are directed by [[Hayato Date]], and produced by [[Pierrot (company)|Pierrot]] and [[TV Tokyo]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/naruto/staff/index.html|script-title=ja:スタッフ・キャスト|trans-title=Staff.Cast |publisher=TV Tokyo|language=ja|access-date=October 28, 2011}}</ref> The nineteenth season aired from January to May 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/naruto/episodes/episodes33/index.html|title=Episodes 614-625|publisher=TV Tokyo|language=ja|access-date=July 3, 2015}}</ref>

The season would make its English television debut on [[Adult Swim]]'s [[Toonami]] programming block and aired from June 12 to October 9, 2022.

The season's collection in DVD started on September 2, 2015 under the title of {{Nihongo|'''In Naruto's Footsteps: Friends' Paths'''|ナルトの背中 ～仲間の軌跡～|Naruto no Senaka: Nakama no Kiseki}}.

The season contains four musical themes between two openings and two endings. The opening theme songs are "[[Silhouette (Kana-Boon song)|Silhouette]]" performed by [[Kana-Boon]] (used for episodes 394 to 405) and {{Nihongo|"Kaze"|風||"Wind"}} performed by Yamazaru (used for episodes 406 to 413). The ending theme songs are "Spinning World" performed by [[Diana Garnet]] (used for episodes 394 to 405) and {{Nihongo|"Kotoba no Iranai Yakusoku"|言葉のいらない約束||"A Promise That Needs No Words"}} performed by [[Sana (singer)|Sana]] (used for episodes 406 to 413).

| ShortSummary    = While [[Sakura Haruno]] recovers [[Naruto Uzumaki]], Tsunade recalls one of her memories about her, the new Kazekage Gaara and siblings starting the new Chunin Exams for some ninja students. After explaining that the Akatsuki will interfere the exam, they start the event for any conspirators who tries to start the coup d'état against them. After arranging the exams to first begin at the Leaf Village and end at the Sand, Tsunade sends out the ANBU to deliver invitations to all the Kages, but they refuse to have their villagers take part in the exams.
